Being around Hinata, who’s as radiant and captivating as the sun, made Shinji feel pitiful by comparison, so at some point, he began to feel a bit uncomfortable around him. On the other hand, Hinata’s younger sister, Tsukina, treats him more kindly than she treats her own brother, for some reason.
